I love this organizer. It took only two days to arrive ! I can fit most of my makeup on in it. It's super clear and pretty heavy. The drawers are easy to slide in and out. The mesh is useful. It's not too small yet too big. Just right for my vanity since I have this spinner organizer on it too and didn't want the organizer to be too big. Don't go to the container store and waste your money on those plastic expensive organizers and GET THIS! It is worth ALL THE PENNIES ! Thank you Melody Susie !!

Okay so i really like this organizer. Mostly, because so far its the only one i have found that has a large bottom drawer. Every other organizer like this one, all have the same short thin drawers. Fine for most eye shadows, but what about your blushers, bronzers and powders. That's why you need at least one deep drawer. The top portion is fine it hold most of my stuff, no problem. But seriously big drawer, only one i have seen so far.

reviews.t: A great acrylic organizer for makeup
reviews.x: A great acrylic organizer for makeup. There are three separate pieces that you can either keep all separate or shove together for two units. Only downside is that the drawers aren't deep, as well as the top dividers to makeup brushes, eyeliner, etc aren't deep at all. Can't keep my brush sets or anything longer than 3 inches tall in them.

I had looked and looked for something like this, but they were all over $100 bucks!  I bought this for my daughter thinking it may hold 1/2 of her stuff, but surprisingly it HELD everything and she has a lot of makeup. Its easy to put together, its sturdy, and you can use it to store jewlery too, there is that much room in there.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the organizer as sturdy, durable, and well-made from thick clear acrylic.
Many reviewers find it fits their everyday makeup well, with a large bottom drawer that accommodates bigger items like palettes and powders.
Some reviewers say it is smaller than expected or not truly 'large,' and that the spaces don't fit makeup well.
A few reviewers report drawer problems, such as a top drawer issue or a bottom drawer that is badly set and hard to open.
Reviewers appreciate the clear, attractive appearance and easy-to-clean design.
